basis.amount_unit: mol of named independent MELTS liquid component
basis.standard: pure liquid endmember at supplied T_K/P_Pa; no separate pressure correction
basis.activity_convention: activity, ln_activity, ln_gamma use backend_R; ln_activity_common_R = (mu - mu0)/(common_R*T_K); ln_gamma_common_R = ln_activity_common_R - ln(x)
basis.mole_fraction_convention: x and ln_gamma use independent component amounts; backend_species.x reports internal species, including carbonate in mode 4.
basis.mixing: Full potentials already include ideal and excess mixing; do not add mixing again.

native_standard_state_receipts.standard_state_policy: Native pure-liquid mu0 at this exact T/P; no fitted offset or pressure interpolation.

janaf_atomic_reference.reference_convention: Hf(298.15 K) + H(T)-H(298.15 K) - T*S(T), with absolute entropy and p0=1 bar; not delta-f G(T).
janaf_atomic_reference.interpolation: Cubic Hermite G(T), derivative -S at each tabulated node.
janaf_atomic_reference.data_extraction: Numeric excerpts transcribed from the linked primary HTML/TXT tables; not byte copies of downloads.

numerical_initialization.scope: Numerical metal-free starting point only; no atom floor, new phase constraint, thermodynamic change, or relaxed acceptance tolerance.

atmosphere.amount_basis: Finite atomic amounts, internally minimized into gas plus retained cloud.
atmosphere.retention: Full retention; atmospheric Fe condensate is distinct from the deep alloy.
atmosphere.pressure: Gas partial pressures sum to total pressure; clouds add mass without gas pressure.
atmosphere.upper_reference_policy: Re-evaluate raw FastChem reactions at every layer T/P. Conserved-element gauges cancel from isolated parcel composition; no low-temperature JANAF extrapolation or frozen source chemical potentials.
atmosphere.pure_phase_reference_policy: FastChem pure condensates and native MELTS phases are independent thermochemical models. Matching formulas do not establish matching energies or a calibrated phase boundary.
